Package GUI

Class MyReservationsController

java.lang.Object
GUI.MyReservationsController
public class MyReservationsController extends Object
Controller class for the MyReservations.fxml view.

This class manages the traveler's personal reservation dashboard inside the GoNature system. It provides a comprehensive matrix showing all historical and future bookings, dynamically colors order statuses inside the table cells, and allows users to update parameters (date, time, group volume) or delete existing reservations. Front-end constraints ensure users don't reschedule bookings to past dates or choose visitor counts exceeding business bounds.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the view elements automatically upon construction of the FXML scene graph.

      Connects cell factor mapping properties, injects color rules to highlight discrete booking status paths, builds default operational hour choices (08:00 to 18:30), and attaches row selection listening monitors to populate modification controls when an existing row is clicked.

    • getTravelerType

      private String getTravelerType()
      Determines the pricing and profile classification string corresponding to the current session details.
      Returns:
      A category string identifying the user context ("GUIDE", "SUBSCRIBER", or "VISITOR").

    • refreshTable

      private void refreshTable()
      Pulls the history list of bookings from the server for the currently active traveler profile. Fallback queries are dispatched utilizing default mock parameters if a user context is absent.

    • setReservationsTable

      public void setReservationsTable(ArrayList<ArrayList<String>> rows)
      Re-renders the graphical table item mapping with fresh data arrays supplied from server results. Called asynchronously from network connection update handlers.
      Parameters:
      rows - Multi-dimensional sequence list containing fresh database reservation fields.

    • handleUpdateReservation

      void handleUpdateReservation(ActionEvent event)
      Evaluates modification fields, performs data bounds checks, and forwards an adjustment command to the server socket to update the selected reservation.
      Parameters:
      event - Action trigger originating from interacting with the update button.

    • handleDeleteReservation

      void handleDeleteReservation(ActionEvent event)
      Transmits a removal command payload to delete the selected reservation row from the server database registry. It optimistically changes row elements status markers locally to prevent duplicate click submissions.
      Parameters:
      event - Action trigger event mapping to the reservation delete/cancel button.
